title: Lighthouse Handoff Product Bridge
purpose: Provide Chrome extension discovery, CORS allowlist policy enforcement, PageSpeed payload transformation, Local AI report enhancement mode, and coding-agent-ready Markdown export.
problem: Lighthouse Handoff requires a formal product bridge to interface between browser extensions, PageSpeed JSON outputs, and Local AI enhancement without exposing unauthorized CORS endpoints.

included: Extension discovery and CORS allowlist enforcement (127.0.0.1, chrome-extension://*)
PageSpeed JSON payload converter to coding-agent-ready Markdown
Local AI enhancement mode for prioritizing critical accessibility and performance recommendations
CLI and module interface with acceptance test suite scripts/test-lighthouse-product-bridge.js

acceptanceCriteria.description: Bridge enforces CORS allowlist policy rejecting unauthorized remote origins
PageSpeed JSON payloads are transformed into structured, coding-agent-ready Markdown reports
Local AI enhancement mode adds prioritized recommendation summaries to report output
